scope_note: Coverage is limited to the format classes listed here and to the synthetic samples exercised by scripts/tests/test_secret_detection_matrix.py; it does not claim that every secret is detectable. The scanner (scripts/secret_scan.py) and DLP (shared/dlpSanitizer.js) keep their own general rules. Known limits registered under B-113 and not resolved here: the scanner skips tracked or staged content it cannot read instead of failing, and it exempts matches containing placeholder words such as TEST; coverage conclusions apply only to content the scanner actually reads and to tokens without such words.

GOOGLE_API_KEY.supported_format: AIza followed by exactly 35 characters from [0-9A-Za-z_-], not adjacent to another character from that set

NO_DISTINCTIVE_PREFIX.reason: No stable prefix; only context-based general rules apply (for example the scanner LINE_CREDENTIAL field-context rule)

RANDOM_GENERATED_NO_PREFIX.reason: Locally generated random material without a prefix; only general heuristics apply

UNKNOWN.reason: Format not established; revisit when the format is confirmed

NOT_APPLICABLE.reason: Registered-only entries managed by external tools
